objectives: Reduce unnecessary Gemini fallback without material definitive-coverage loss
Make benchmark continuation durable and avoid restarting successful or uncertain paid tasks
Use profiles to decide whether C++ can improve end-to-end latency

experiments.hypothesis: A separately calibrated high-confidence insufficient-evidence gate can return MAYBE locally without losing more than 2 percentage points of potential definitive coverage.
experiments.mapping: Logistic correctness mapping fitted on old calibration fit groups only, restricted to existing head's MAYBE candidates. Gate scores are not truth probabilities.
experiments.selection: Old validation only: maximize fallback avoidance subject to <=1% observed false-abstention/all; no new calibration or locked outcomes used for selection.
experiments.risk_gate: One fixed policy evaluated once on 400 fresh independent components, one question per component, deterministic hash selection with no class filtering. One-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on false-abstention/all must be <=2%, and at least 5% calls avoided. Reject rather than retune on this risk set.
experiments.heldout: 200 additional fresh independent components, sealed before inference; one-shot local assessment only after policy freeze. Previous scored cohorts never count as fresh.

experiments.hypothesis: Durable per-task and per-call journal permits safe continuation after process/provider failure without duplicate successful/uncertain paid work.
experiments.acceptance: SQLite transactions durably reserve requests/spend before provider work; checkpoint transitions; refuse input/model/policy mismatches; restart marks outstanding work uncertain and does not silently retry it; failure reasons never mean falsehood. Wall-time preflight stops before launching a call that cannot fit.

experiments.hypothesis: Native inference already dominates local evaluation; a C++ rewrite is justified only if Python accounts for enough of end-to-end time.
experiments.gate: Record cProfile costs and an Amdahl upper bound before any native implementation. Retain Python unless measured bottleneck and meaningful total benefit justify new build/maintenance cost.

experiments.hypothesis: A fixed .80 insufficiency-score threshold, after A01 selected no cases at >=.90, may avoid useful fallback while preserving coverage. It never authorizes definitive YES/NO.
experiments.selection: A new separately named candidate; fixed .80 before evaluating it. Old validation loss <=1% and skip >=5% required before fresh risk use.
experiments.risk_gate: Same untouched 400-component risk cohort; one-sided CP upper false-abstention/all <=2%; no retuning after risk outcomes.

experiments.hypothesis: Combined context plus per-passage max/mean/min NLI signals improve simple aggregation without adding generative models.
experiments.architecture: Same pinned encoder; one C=1 logistic head, seed1911, max_iter500; deduplicate exact passage text, cap eight passages and abstain when truncated.
experiments.gate: Calibrated old validation accuracy and definitive coverage must not decrease; selective error must not increase. Otherwise reject before fresh tests. No production promotion from validation.

experiments.hypothesis: Domain fine-tuning the existing compact semantic evaluator addresses evidence-understanding failures that score calibration and richer aggregation did not repair.
experiments.training: Exactly one epoch over 2000 existing development claims; seed1912, AdamW lr2e-5 weight_decay.01, batch8, max_length256, CPU threads2. Stop training after900 seconds; partial epochs are rejected. No fresh/locked examples or Gemini labels.
experiments.resources: Isolated CPU-only torch2.15.0+cpu/transformers5.23.0 environment; one pinned safetensors base; combined new package/weight downloads bounded1GB. No GPU, cloud provisioning or paid API calls.
experiments.gate: One fixed logistic aggregator and existing disjoint correctness-calibration process. Retain research only if old validation accuracy/coverage do not decrease and selective error does not increase; reject otherwise. New 400/200 independent components remain unscored until the final policy is frozen.
experiments.export: Safe weights only; no remote Python model code. Export ONNX and verify parity before runtime use. No trained weights publicly redistributed.

experiments.hypothesis: A newly fine-tuned verifier may need a different calibrated operating threshold; choose the best safe policy using old validation, then freeze before fresh risk/test.
experiments.reference: Current stable research routing policy: original FP32 logistic at .85, not a weaker raw head.
experiments.gate: Choose maximal correct-definitive coverage with no validation accuracy/definitive-coverage loss or selective-risk increase versus .85 reference. Scores remain calibrated correctness estimates, not guarantees. Fresh risk and locked sets remain unscored until chosen policy is frozen.

data_policy: Original FEVER human labels and pinned gold evidence mirror; same rights review as existing local research. Source text/weights remain outside Apache repository. Exclude any component sharing page/subject/claim with previous original dataset. No AVeriTeC.
stopping: Local resource bound, unavailable independent evidence, or three consecutive controlled experiments without material improvement. Preserve failures, no universal-optimum claim.
production: No automatic promotion or public release. Existing confidence floor, products and OPS preserved. New paid runs require a concrete separately authorized budget.

balanced_panel_amendment.reason: Strict whole-page graph residual is ~90% MAYBE, so it cannot support a broad accuracy claim. Before scoring any new cases, add a separate balanced fact/entity-disjoint panel; preserve original strict natural regime and its untouched locked data.
balanced_panel_amendment.risk: 600 groups, 200/label; exact source sentence/normalized span, primary entity, leading subject and claim disjoint from prior dataset and between splits. Pages may overlap and this weaker split is explicitly reported.
balanced_panel_amendment.locked: 300 additional groups, 100/label, sealed before inference. Never retune on risk or locked outcomes.
balanced_panel_amendment.coverage_diagnostic: Per-YES/NO-stratum one-sided CP bounds with Bonferroni alpha .025 each; balanced overall false-abstention bound is their sum divided by3. No claim of universal shift-proof risk control.

risk_power_extension.time: Before scoring any fresh risk or locked examples
risk_power_extension.justification: Old validation gate false-abstention rate3/480 implies 600 balanced risk questions may be underpowered for a2% coverage-opportunity-loss bound. Increase to1200,400/class, with fixed policy and alpha.025/class. Preserve all existing risk/locked files and assign additional unused whole components only.
risk_power_extension.not_allowed: No second threshold selection or sample-size change after fresh outcomes are inspected.

successor_episode.reason: One-epoch fine-tune improved balanced validation but failed strict-page heldout factual reliability (40.6% selected error). Do not promote globally.
successor_episode.A08: Add original pretrained NLI semantic agreement at score>=.5 before definitive fine-tuned decisions. Calibrate final guarded score separately on each retired risk regime, use the minimum estimated correctness at fixed .85. No false independence claim.
successor_episode.data_rule: All already scored balanced1200+300 and strict400+200 become retired fit/diagnostic data. Create separate successor risk and locked panels before evaluating this successor.
successor_episode.gate: Independent error upper bound<=20% in BOTH regimes and no material accuracy/coverage loss versus the old .85 research route. Do not retune on successor outcomes. Qualified MAYBE gate signal unchanged, rebind only with identical original fine-model features and assess again.
successor_episode.scope: A separate bounded local architecture episode, max30 additional minutes, no new cloud spending or public release.

safe_specialist_successor.A10: Retain the original .85 verifier for definitive decisions. Invoke the new fine-tuned model only after original abstention, solely to apply its previously qualified .90 insufficiency gate. Never permit the specialist to emit YES/NO.
safe_specialist_successor.safety_argument: Original local definitive answers remain identical. New local abstentions are a subset of the already assessed insufficiency selections, so unconditional false-abstention opportunity loss cannot exceed the qualified selector bound under those population assumptions. This is not a bound under arbitrary shift.
safe_specialist_successor.comparison: Compare fallback requirements and missed definitive opportunities on untouched successor panels; do not claim Gemini accuracy/latency without live calls.
safe_specialist_successor.data_availability_amendment: The first successor construction failed before writing or scoring any cases because excluding entire new strict page components also from the fact-based panel left only105YES cases. Keep each regime definition, but exclude cross-regime duplicate fact/entity components rather than all shared background pages. Disclose possible cross-regime correlation; do not pool the panels. No seen groups or predictions used for selection.
safe_specialist_successor.A08_status: Rejected before successor scoring: worst-regime calibration collapsed retired balanced coverage to12.5% and strict coverage to1%, not a useful upgrade.

amendments.change: Added pinned mirror test.jsonl crosschecked against official shared_task_dev: 9847 accepted, zero original-ID overlap with prior mirror valid. Strict and fact components recomputed across train plus added cohort. Fresh balanced locked size reduced to 60 per class before scoring; only 73 unused supported components remained after 200/class risk. No model scores used.

amendments.stage: before successor scoring; both earlier builders failed before writing
amendments.change: Refuting components were scarcer than supporting: only213 total available under the unchanged exclusion rule. Seal balanced risk100/class and locked100/class, no outcome-based selection. Preserve original failed construction attempts in history.
